from: August book, night 6 (I Am Doing a Great Work)
p1: The wall around Jerusalem was almost done. Only the doors for the gates were left.
Some men did not want the wall finished. They sent Nehemiah a message: “Come down and meet with us.” But they wanted to make trouble for him.
Nehemiah sent back his answer. “I am doing a great work, so I cannot come down. Why should the work stop?”
p2: Four times they asked, and four times Nehemiah said the same thing. The wall was finished in just 52 days! Even the people all around knew Heavenly Father had helped.
Your good work is great too, like being kind and helping at home. Tonight, think of one good job you want to finish tomorrow.
old: As the people built the walls, some grumpy men tried to stop them. They laughed and teased. “You can’t do it!” they said. But the people just kept building.
The workers were wise. They held a building tool in one hand and stayed close together, trusting Heavenly Father to keep them safe. “Heavenly Father will fight for us,” they said.
The grumpy men tried a sneaky trick. “Come down and talk to us,” they called, again and again, hoping Nehemiah would stop his important work.

But Nehemiah stood tall on the wall and called back, “I am doing a great work, so I cannot come down!” He would not let anything pull him away from Heavenly Father’s job. And in just fifty-two days, the wall was finished!
